chunks.title: Purpose.
chunks.heading: Purpose.
chunks.text: The Document described understanding of changes required on Order Access Procurement Approval.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text: Currently PO excess approver logic treat inquiry order procurement in it which we require to be excluded while validating excess procurement qty. The simple reason is inquiry orders gets spitted into confirmed orders and procurements already started against inquiry orders. So at one point of time, inquiry order indent line will be 0 and all the revision of PO/Creation will lead to excess procurement approval

chunks.title: 1. PO Excess Procurement Issue
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › 1. PO Excess Procurement Issue
chunks.text:
Currently, the PO excess approver logic “Order Access Procurement Approval” incorrectly includes inquiry order procurement while validating excess procurement quantity. This needs to be excluded.
The reason is that inquiry orders are later split into confirmed orders, and procurement activities (indent, RMPO, GRN) are already initiated based on the inquiry order. As a result, at a certain stage:
• Inquiry order quantity becomes 0
• Confirmed (summary) order quantity reflects the actual requirement
However, during PO revision or creation, the system still considers this as excess procurement and triggers unnecessary approval, even though:
• At the Main OC / Style level, the total quantity remains unchanged and within limits
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › 1. PO Excess Procurement Issue

chunks.title: Example Scenario:
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › 1. PO Excess Procurement Issue › Example Scenario:
chunks.text:
• Inquiry Order = 200
• Indent generated
• RMPO created against indent
• GRN created
• Summary Order received and split into Summary OCs (Total = 200)
• Inquiry Order = 0
• Summary Order = 200
• Indent revised
• During RMPO revision, system flags Excess Quantity and asks for approval
This is incorrect because the actual requirement has not changed.
Reference Example: MTX-002073-001 (Metrex Test)
